name: blubberize
title: blubberize
blurb: Bluesky but every account is a seal, sized by real followersCount. type your handle and a target's, hit FISSION, and projectile off half your blubber to render them BLUBBERIZED (unable to post — cosmetically, not really). sign in and the fission itself is real: a signed record written to your own PDS, live in a network-wide log. @norvid-studies.bsky.social riffed on gracekind.net's "every account is a seal sized by followers" post with the fission mechanic, then asked the bot to "make it real."
